lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters organized in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the gill region, forming a non-uniform grid pattern with larger blobs spaced roughly equidistantly along primary vertical bands.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical high-intensity bands intersect with horizontal alignments of spots, creating a grid-like lattice structure across the mid-lateral flank where blobs serve as nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible running across the upper and mid flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse, small-diameter high-luminance spots distributed across the distal and central visible surface of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct dark elongated silhouette, characteristic of a remora, is visible in the ventral water column beneath the pectoral fin.
